name: Floating Dock
author: dino
description: Floating dock: pinned launchers, running apps with click-to-focus and window cycling, hover window previews with minimize/maximize/close, right-click menu (minimize, maximize, new window, window jump list, quit, pin/unpin), Launchpad-style app launcher with search, drag-to-reorder, auto-hide, four placements (bottom/top/left/right), running-app ring indicators.
